capabilities.justification: Reads OCaml source files and the package capability manifest under review.
Discovers regular OCaml source files beneath the selected package directory.
Integration tests create isolated temporary package directories.
Integration tests write bounded source and manifest fixtures into temporary directories.
Integration tests remove every temporary file and directory during cleanup.
Prints deterministic findings and tool errors for developers and CI.

justification: The analyzer reads and lists one selected package tree and prints its deterministic verdict. Its test suite creates, writes, and removes only isolated temporary fixtures; production opens no network connection and starts no process.
